<span style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><i>Point at the Mulberry Tree While Cursing the Locust Tree</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
  <span style="color: #333333; font-family: 'Noto Sans CJK SC Regular', sans-serif; font-size: large;">
    Influencing an adversary’s behavior by sending a message can sometimes only be done covertly, through indirect means. To control an opponent whose position prevents the option of direct confrontation or criticism, sending a message by disciplining or punishing someone else will often suffice.
  </span>
</p>

<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
  <span style="color: #333333; font-family: 'Noto Sans CJK SC Regular', sans-serif; font-size: large;">
    Sun Tzu wanted to show King Helü (<span lang="zh-CN">阖闾</span>, reigned from 514 to 496 B.C.) of Wu that even women could be trained in the arts of war. He put together two regiments consisting of women from Helü's court, and then put two of the king's favorite concubines at the head of each. After giving both regiments clear instructions, he began to give them marching orders, but both groups just giggled confusedly. He had the concubines beheaded, and then put two women from the front rows in charge and gave the order a second time. This time, they obeyed. It was in this way that Sun Tzu made his point to the king [16].
  </span>
</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: Liberation Serif, serif; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Point
at the Mulberry Tree While Cursing the Locust </span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><i>Tree</i>
is associated with the seventh hexagram, <i>Earth
over Water</i>. The
Water below represents a dangerous force, and the Earth above is the
discipline and obedience which guides it. The yang line in the second
position is the head commanding this obedience, just as does a
commanding general through reward and punishment [1],
[28].</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span></p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">&nbsp;</span>

	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">6</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">)
	Q: <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">屋顶上有蜘蛛，是有毒的吗？</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">A:
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">是的，这一种蜘蛛有毒。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">7)</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: times;"> </span></span><span style="color: #ffa400; font-size: large;"><span style="color: #0047AB !important;">他很生气地骂了出来。</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	8) I. <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">请接受我的材料。</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">&nbsp;&nbsp; </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">II.
	<span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我让小王接收一下。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	9) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这个把手，我应该推过去，还是拉过来？</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Should I push or pull
	this handle?</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;">
	10)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">天哪！橄榄球上有蜜蜂！</span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Lord! There’s a bee
	on the football!</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><br /></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;">
	<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: large;"><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">11</span></span><span style="font-family: Liberation Serif, Times New Roman, serif;"><span lang="en-US">)
	</span></span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular; font-size: large;"><span lang="zh-CN">让我们把这个大箱子抬起来，小箱子推</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;下去吧。</span></span></div>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="color: #333333;">
-------------------------------------</span></p>
